Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:11:1.english: What is your thinking - That you do not consider him [to be] a relative.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:11:2.hebrew: לא אונן - אם מתה, אינו נאסר בקדשים מחמת אנינות:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:11:2.english: [He] does not enter acute mourning - If she dies, he is not prohibited from [eating] sacrificial food on account of acute mourning.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:11:3.hebrew: ואין מטמא לה - אם כהן הוא. ואית דל"ג "אינה מטמאה". וכן היא — אינה נאסרת באנינות מיתתו בקדשים. ואינה מטמאה — אינה מצווה להתעסק בו. ואיידי דתניא "לא אוננת", תנא "ולא מיטמאת" — ולאו דווקא, דנשים דכהונה לא הוזהרו על הטומאה:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:11:3.english: Nor does he become ritually impure for her - If he is a priest. And some do not have the reading: "She does not become ritually impure." And [as for] "and likewise she" — she is not forbidden [from eating] consecrated foods due to acute mourning over his death. And [as for] "nor does she become ritually impure" — she is not commanded to attend to him. And since [the Tanna] taught "she does not enter acute mourning," he taught "nor does she become ritually impure"; but [this] is not strictly precise, because women of the priesthood were not cautioned against ritual impurity.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:11:4.hebrew: גובה כתובתה - בדכתב לה מן האירוסין מוקמינן לה בשנים אוחזין (ב"מ דף יח.). ואהא דקתני לא מטמא לה קא סמכת, ואמרת: לאו קרוב הוא:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:11:4.english: She collects her marriage contract - [This refers to a case] where he wrote [it] for her from [the time of] betrothal; we establish it [as such] in the chapter [entitled] Shenayim Ochazin (Bava Metzia 18a). And upon that which it teaches, "he does not become ritually impure for her," you were relying, and [therefore] said: "He is not a relative."

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:12:1.english: There - With regard to ritual impurity and inheritance.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:12:2.hebrew: בשארו תלה רחמנא - כדכתיב (ויקרא כ״א:ב׳) כי אם לשארו הקרוב, ואמר מר (יבמות דף כב:): שארו — זו אשתו. וכן בירושת הבעל: לשארו הקרוב אליו ממשפחתו וירש אותה — מיכן שהבעל יורש את אשתו, ביש נוחלין (ב"ב קט:):
Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:12:2.english: The Merciful One renders it dependent on “his kin” - As it is written: “Except for his kin that is near” (Leviticus 21:2), and the Master said (Yevamot 22b): “His kin” — this is his wife. And similarly regarding the husband’s inheritance: “To his kin that is near to him of his family, and he shall inherit her” (Numbers 27:11) — from here [it is derived] that a husband inherits his wife, in [the chapter] Yesh Noḥalin (Bava Batra 109b).

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:13:1.hebrew: גיסו - לבדו, אבל בנו וחתנו כשרים לגיסו. ורבי יוסי פליג אמתני' בתרתי: חדא, דקתני מתני' בגיסו בן וחתן; ופליג נמי אבעל אחות אמו, דקתני מתני' דהוה קרוב, וכן גם הוא קרוב לו — דהוי לו בן גיסו — פסול הוא לו משום דאיהו לדידיה בעל אחות אמו, אבל משום קורבה דבן גיסו לא מיפסיל, ונפקא מינה דחתן גיסו כשר להעיד לו. (והוא הדין לגיסו, והיינו דקתני בברייתא בתרייתא: ר' יהודה אומר חורגו — אף חורגו, דמודה נמי בגיסו, ואתא ר' יוסי למימר גיסו לבדו, והוא הדין לחורגו.) זה"ו נוס"ח אח"ר בפי', ונראה: גיסו לבדו, ורבי יוסי פליג אמתניתין בחדא, דקתני מתני' גיסו ובנו וחתנו (כשרים לגיסו), דאבעל אחות אמו דקתני מתניתין דהוי קרוב, וכן גם הוא קרוב לו דהוי ליה בן גיסו — לא פליג רבי יוסי עלה, ומודה הוא דבן גיסו פסול לו משום דאיהו לדידיה בעל אחות אמו, אבל משום קורבה דבן גיסו לא מפסיל, ונפקא מינה דחתן גיסו כשר וכו':
Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:13:1.english: His brother-in-law - Meaning, his brother-in-law alone, but his son and his son-in-law are fit to testify regarding his brother-in-law. And Rabbi Yosei disagrees with the Mishnah in two matters: One, that the Mishnah teaches regarding his brother-in-law that his son and son-in-law are also disqualified; and he also disagrees regarding the husband of his mother's sister, where the Mishnah teaches that he is a relative, and likewise he is also a relative to him — as he is to him the son of his brother-in-law — he is disqualified from testifying about him because he is to him the husband of his mother's sister, but on account of the relationship of being the son of the brother-in-law he is not disqualified, and the practical difference is that the son-in-law of the brother-in-law is fit to testify for him. (And the same applies to his brother-in-law, and this is why the latter baraita teaches: Rabbi Yehuda says, "His stepson" — meaning even his stepson, as he also agrees regarding his brother-in-law, and Rabbi Yosei came to say, "His brother-in-law alone," and the same applies to his stepson.) This is another version in the commentary, and it appears proper to explain: "His brother-in-law alone" — and Rabbi Yosei disagrees with the Mishnah in only one matter: where the Mishnah teaches his brother-in-law and his son and his son-in-law (are fit regarding his brother-in-law); for regarding the husband of his mother's sister, where the Mishnah teaches that he is a relative, and likewise he is also a relative to him, as he is to him the son of his brother-in-law — Rabbi Yosei does not disagree with it, and he concedes that the son of his brother-in-law is disqualified from testifying about him because he is to him the husband of his mother's sister, but on account of the relationship of being the son of the brother-in-law he is not disqualified, and the practical difference is that the son-in-law of the brother-in-law is fit, etc.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:14:1.hebrew: מאי גיסו דקאמר רבי יוסי אף גיסו - ומר אמר חדא, ומר אמר חדא, ולא פליגי:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:14:1.english: What is [the meaning of] “his brother-in-law” that Rabbi Yosei said? [It means] “his brother-in-law as well” - And [one] Master stated one [case], and [the other] Master stated one [case], and they do not disagree.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:15:1.hebrew: הכי גרסינן - אלא הכי קאמר: חורגו לבדו, אבל גיסו — הוא ובנו וחתנו; ואתא רבי יוסי למימר: גיסו לבדו, אבל חורגו — הוא ובנו וחתנו:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:15:1.english: This is our reading - Rather, this is what it is saying: His stepson alone [is disqualified], but his brother-in-law — he, and his son, and his son-in-law [are disqualified]; and Rabbi Yosei comes to say: His brother-in-law alone [is disqualified], but his stepson — he, and his son, and his son-in-law [are disqualified].

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:16:1.hebrew: אלא הא דתני רבי חייא כו' לא רבי יהודה ולא ר' יוסי - דלר' יהודה ט' אבות הוויין במתני' בר מחורגו, וכן לר' יוסי תשעה הווין:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:16:1.english: Rather, that which Rabbi Ḥiyya taught, etc., [is] neither [in accordance with] Rabbi Yehuda nor Rabbi Yosei - For according to Rabbi Yehuda, there are nine "fathers" [principal relatives] in the mishna aside from his stepson, and similarly, according to Rabbi Yosei, there are nine.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:17:1.hebrew: אלא חורגו לבדו - אבל גיסו — הוא ובנו וחתנו — ואתא ר' יוסי למימר: גיסו לבדו, וכל שכן חורגו:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:17:1.english: Rather, his stepson alone - But [as for] his brother-in-law, he, and his son, and his son-in-law [are disqualified]; and Rabbi Yosei comes to say: His brother-in-law alone, and all the more so his stepson.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:17:2.english: And the Mishnah [is] Rabbi Yehuda - For it teaches [his] son and [his] son-in-law regarding his brother-in-law.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:17:3.hebrew: ברייתא ר' יוסי - אפיק גיסו וחורגו, הוי ח' אבות ובנים וחתנים. ואית דמוקמי להאי בן גיסו דקא מכשר ר' יוסי, בבן שיש לו לגיסו מאשה אחרת, כי היכי דלא לפלוג ר' יוסי אבעל אחות אמו. ולא מיתוקמ' שפיר, דכל בניהם דמתני' מאותה אשה קאמר. ועוד, אי מאשה אחרת מכשיר ר' יוסי — מכלל דתנא דידן מאשה אחרת נמי פסול, משום קרוב מחמת קרוב — תיקשי לרב חסדא, דאכשר באחי האח; דהשתא בן גיסו פסול משום אחי בן אחות אשתו, אחי האח מיבעיא:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:17:3.english: The baraita [is] Rabbi Yosei - Remove his brother-in-law and his stepson, [and] there are eight fathers [principal relatives, whose] sons and sons-in-law [are disqualified, totaling twenty-four]. And some establish this son of his brother-in-law whom Rabbi Yosei deems fit as [referring to] a son that his brother-in-law has from another woman, so that Rabbi Yosei does not disagree regarding the husband of his mother's sister. But this is not well established, for all [mentions of] "their sons" in the Mishnah mean from that [same] woman. And furthermore, if Rabbi Yosei deems fit [a son] from another woman, implying that our Tanna disqualifies [a son] from another woman as well because of [being a] relative through a relative, it would pose a difficulty to Rav Ḥisda, who deemed the brother of the brother fit; for if now the son of his brother-in-law is disqualified because [he is] the brother of the son of his wife's sister, is [the disqualification of] the brother of the brother necessary [to mention]?

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:19:1.hebrew: הלכה כר' יוסי - קס"ד כר' יוסי דמתני', דלא פסול אלא קרוב הראוי לירש, וגיסו אינו ראוי ליורשו:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:19:1.english: The halakha is in accordance with Rabbi Yosei - It entered [our] minds [that he meant] in accordance with Rabbi Yosei of the Mishnah, that only a relative who is eligible to inherit is disqualified, and his brother-in-law is not eligible to inherit from him.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:1:1.english: Scrolls of parchment - Sheets of parchment.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:1:2.hebrew: באשת חורגו - על נכסי מלוג שלה, בהשפטה עם אדם מן השוק. ובנשי שאר קרובים לא איבעי להו — דכיון דבניהם פסולין לו והוא להם, פסול אף לנשים, לפי שהבנים ראויין לירש את אמן; אבל חורגו, דבנו כשר — מיבעי' לן באשתו:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:1:2.english: With regard to the wife of his stepson - [This refers to testifying] concerning her usufruct property [nikhsei melog], when she is in litigation with a person from the marketplace. And regarding the wives of other relatives they did not ask, for since their sons are disqualified [to testify] concerning him and he concerning them, [he is] disqualified regarding the wives as well, because the sons stand to inherit their mother; but [as for] his stepson, whose son is fit [to testify], the dilemma is raised concerning his wife.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:20:1.english: Who disqualifies [one's] brother-in-law - For [the baraita] teaches: “His brother-in-law alone.”

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:21:1.hebrew: לא ס"ד - דהא בהדיא פריש שמואל לפסולא דגיסו: כגון אנא ופנחס, שהיה אחיו וגיסו — מכלל דגיסו דעלמא כשרין:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:21:1.english: Do not let it enter your mind - For Shmuel explicitly explained the disqualification of [one's] brother-in-law: such as "myself and Pineḥas" — who was his brother and his brother-in-law — which implies that ordinary brothers-in-law are valid.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:22:1.hebrew: משום גיסו - ושמואל פירושא דגיסו אתא לאשמעי':
Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:22:1.english: Because of his brother-in-law - And Shmuel came to teach us the definition of a brother-in-law.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:23:1.english: He said to him - To the recipient of the gift.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:23:2.hebrew: זיל קנייה בעדי מסירה - אם יש לך עדים אחרים שמסר לך שטר זה בפניהם, הביאם ויעידו ותהיה שלך; דסבר כרבי אלעזר, דאמרי' במסכת גיטין (ד' ג:): אפי' לא חתמו בו עדים, אלא שנתנו לה בפני עדים — כשר, וגובה מנכסים משועבדים, שאין העדים חותמים על הגט אלא מפני תקון העולם:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:23:2.english: Go acquire it through witnesses of transmission - If you have other witnesses that he delivered this deed to you in their presence, bring them and let them testify, and the gift will be yours; for Rav Yosef holds in accordance with Rabbi Elazar, as we say in Tractate Gittin (3b): Even if witnesses did not sign on it, but rather he gave it to her in the presence of witnesses — it is valid, and she collects from liened property, for witnesses sign on a bill of divorce only for the betterment of the world.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:24:1.hebrew: במזויף מתוכו - שחתמו בו עדים פסולים, שהוא פסול — דבמאי קני ליה? בהאי שטרא? האי שטרא חספא בעלמא הוא:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:24:1.english: With regard to [a document whose] falsification is inherent in it - where invalid witnesses signed on it, [Rabbi Elazar concedes] that it is invalid. For through what would he acquire it? Through this document? This document is a mere shard!

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:2:1.hebrew: בעל כאשתו - ואשה כבעלה, והרי הוא כאילו חמיה, ותנן (דף כז:): חמיו פסול, קרוב הוא:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:2:1.english: A husband is like his wife - And a wife is like her husband, and behold, he is as if [he were] his father-in-law; and we learned (27b): "His father-in-law is disqualified" — [for] he is a relative.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:5:1.hebrew: אחי האח - בן שיש לבעל אמו מאשה אחרת, פסול לו, מפני שהוא אחי אחיו:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:5:1.english: The brother of the brother - A son that his mother's husband has from another woman is disqualified [from testifying] for him, because he is the brother of his brother.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:8:1.hebrew: אבי חתן ואבי כלה - בן ראובן שנשא בת שמעון, לא נתקרבו ראובן ושמעון בכך, וכשרין להעיד זה לזה בכל עדיות. ולא אמרינן: בשביל בנו שנתקרב ראובן לשמעון, נפסל ראובן לשמעון:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:8:1.english: The father of the groom and the father of the bride - [If] the son of Reuben married the daughter of Simon, Reuben and Simon have not become related through this, and they are fit to testify for one another in all testimonies. And we do not say: On account of his son, through whom Reuben became connected to Simon, Reuben is disqualified concerning Simon.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:8:2.english: And they are not similar - Reuven and Shimon to each other.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:8:3.english: Only like a stopper to a barrel - Like a stopper, which is not similar to the barrel.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:9:1.hebrew: לאפוקי מינה - לחוב לה ולזכות לבעל דינה, דקרוב לא הוי כל זמן שלא נשאה. ומיהו, לעיולי לה לא מהימן, דאדעתא דידיה קעביד:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 28b:9:1.english: To remove [money] from her - To obligate her and to find in favor of her opposing litigant, for he is not [considered] a relative as long as he has not married her. However, to bring [money] in for her, he is not believed, since he acts with his own interests in mind.

Tosafot on Sanhedrin 28b:17:1.hebrew: גיסו לבדו וכ"ש חורגו - אינם שוים: דחורגו לבדו — למעוטי בנו וחתנו, וגיסו לבדו — לא למעוטי בנו; דהא ברייתא ר' יוסי היא, אלמא חשיב בעל אחות אמו, והיינו בן גיסו, ולא אתא למעוטי אלא חתנו, כדפי' הקונטרס. ומדמסקי' דהלכה כר' יוסי, דגיסו לבדו למעוטי חתנו, יש לדקדק: כ"ש שנים הנשואים שתי בנות אחיות או בנות שני אחים דכשרים:
Tosafot on Sanhedrin 28b:17:1.english: "His brother-in-law alone, and all the more so his stepson" - [These cases] are not equivalent: For "his stepson alone" [serves] to exclude his son and his son-in-law, while "his brother-in-law alone" does not [serve] to exclude his son; for this baraita is [in accordance with] Rabbi Yosei, [and] evidently it counts the husband of his mother's sister [as disqualified], and that is [reciprocally] his brother-in-law's son; and [Rabbi Yosei] came only to exclude his son-in-law, as the Kuntres explained. And since we conclude that the halakhah is in accordance with Rabbi Yosei, that "his brother-in-law alone" [serves] to exclude his son-in-law, it can be inferred that all the more so, two [men] who are married to two daughters of sisters or [to] daughters of two brothers are qualified.

Tosafot on Sanhedrin 28b:24:1.hebrew: והא מודו רבי אלעזר במזויף מתוכו - מדמהדר ליה אביי הכי, משמע דס"ל כרבי אלעזר, דאמר: "עידי מסירה כרתי". אלמא קסבר אביי: כתב לאחד ומסר לאחר — זה שמסר לו קנה, דהכי א"ר אלעזר בסוף מי שהיה נשוי (כתובות דף צד: ושם). ותימה: הא אביי הוא דאמר בפ"ק דב"מ (דף יג. ושם): "עדיו בחתומיו זכין לו"?! וי"ל, דההיא דכתב לאחר מיירי בב' שטרות היוצאים ביום אחד שזמנם שוה, דכיון דלא מוכח מתוך השטר איזה קדם — לא שייך למימר "עדיו בחתומיו זכין לו", ואזלינן בתר מסירה; אבל היכא דמתוך השטר מוכח איזהו קדם — "עדיו בחתומיו זכין לו", ואפילו נמסר לבסוף:
Tosafot on Sanhedrin 28b:24:1.english: "But doesn’t Rabbi Elazar concede with regard to [a document whose] falsification is inherent in it" - From [the fact] that Abaye replied to him in this way, it implies that he holds in accordance with Rabbi Elazar, who said: "Witnesses of delivery effectuate [the transfer]." It follows that Abaye holds: [If one] wrote [a deed] to one person and delivered [it] to another, the one to whom he delivered [it] acquires [it], for so said Rabbi Elazar at the end of [the chapter entitled] Mi SheHaya Nasui (Ketubot 94b, and there). And this is difficult: For Abaye himself is the one who said in the first chapter of Bava Metzia (13a, and there): "Its witnesses acquire [the property] for him by their signatures [on it]"?! And one can say that that [case] where he wrote [to one and delivered] to another deals with two deeds produced on the same day whose dates are identical, for since it is not evident from within the deed which came first, it is not applicable to say "Its witnesses acquire for him by their signatures," and we follow delivery; but where it is evident from within the deed which came first, "its witnesses acquire for him by their signatures," even if it was delivered afterwards.
